Done. Results are in two parts in the working directory.

**`output-1.json`** — ids `x001`–`x340`; **`output-2.json`** — ids `x341`–`x678`. All 678 ids present exactly once.

Conversion rules I applied:

- `//Type[@name="v"]` → `**/Type[\`name == "v"\`]`; `contains()` → `CONTAINS`, `starts-with` → `BEGINSWITH`, `and`/`or` → `AND`/`OR` with the same precedence (XPath `and` binds tighter, as does `AND`).
- `//*[...]` → `**/XCUIElementTypeAny[...]`; `contains(@type,"XCUIElementTypeX")` / `starts-with(@type,...)` folded into the chain's class name when exactly one type can match.
- `(//X[...])[n]` → `[n]`, `last()` → `[-1]`, `last()-1` → `[-2]`.
- `A/B` → `**/A/B`, `A//B` → `**/A/**/B`, absolute paths → root-anchored chains without `**/`.
- Case-folding XPath functions (`translate`, `lower-case`, `upper-case`) → `[c]`-modified comparisons; `matches()` → `MATCHES`/`CONTAINS`.

Skipped (≈110 locators), by reason family: sibling/parent/ancestor/following axes; predicates asserting the existence or count of children (`[.//X]`, `count()`); unions of different element types; per-parent positional predicates like `//X[2]`, `//X[last()]`, `child::*[1]` (class chain indexes apply to the flattened match set, so they find different elements); attributes unavailable to class chain predicates (`@visible`, `@hittable`, `@accessible`, `@selected`, `@index`, `@text`, `@placeholderValue`, `@x`); `text()`/string-value matching; `position()` ranges; and string-rewriting functions with no NSPredicate analogue (`normalize-space`, `tokenize`, `string-join`).

Two cases worth your attention:

- **x530** (`(//XCUIElementTypeStaticText[@label="Bika pejun huregad"])Vq1`) is not valid XPath — the trailing `Vq1` looks like an unsubstituted index template. I emitted the chain for the parenthesised part **without** any index; if `Vq1` was meant to be `[n]`, add `[n]` or treat this one as a skip.
- **x294** (`//XCUIElementTypeButton[@enabled=true()]`): `@enabled = true()` coerces the attribute node-set to a boolean, so it is true for every button that has the attribute, not only enabled ones. I converted it to plain `**/XCUIElementTypeButton`, faithful to the XPath rather than to the likely intent (`enabled == true`).
